stages.label: Traffic allocated
stages.narrative: Modeled demand is conserved across governed landing and cable identities.

stages.label: Failure applied
stages.narrative: Selected cable or landing failures remove capacity and expose disconnected demand.

stages.label: Traffic rerouted
stages.narrative: The allocation policy redistributes service until corridors saturate or demand drops.

stages.label: Repair and settlement
stages.narrative: Repair resources restore capacity while throughput and fairness settle against baseline.

seeds.label: Atlantic single cut
seeds.description: One modeled MAREA corridor failure with weighted-throughput and proportional-fair comparison.

seeds.label: Regional landing loss
seeds.description: One modeled United Kingdom regional landing dependency is unavailable.

seeds.label: Dual disruption
seeds.description: Two modeled Atlantic capacity corridors fail under higher synthetic demand.

seeds.label: Repair priority
seeds.description: Identical modeled failures expose nearest-first and unmet-demand-first repair ordering.
